description:
ABOUT THE ROLE

As the first machine learning engineer on the team, you will build the ML foundation for software that helps improve farm operations. You will turn fragmented agricultural data into carefully evaluated forecasts and insights that growers can use to make important decisions.


WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Audit and integrate historical data from farm systems, identifying useful signals and data gaps.

 - Build machine learning tools for forecasting, performance analysis, and operational efficiency.

 - Develop backtesting and evaluation frameworks to assess model accuracy before deployment.

 - Create privacy-first, anonymized datasets that support shared learning across farms.

 - Collaborate with product and engineering teammates to present useful insights to farm managers.


WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

 - Two to four years of engineering experience, including shipping production ML models used to inform real decisions.

 - Strong Python and SQL skills, with experience using pandas or polars, scikit-learn, gradient boosting, and forecasting libraries.

 - Experience with tabular or time-series data, data pipelines, and tools that help explain model behavior.

 - A rigorous approach to evaluation, including awareness of data leakage, backtesting, and production readiness.

 - Ability to explain model outputs and uncertainty to non-technical stakeholders.

 - Daily experience building with AI and interest in combining LLMs and agents with classical ML.

 - Experience with large-scale data, messy startup data, or applied forecasting in agriculture, weather, supply chain, or other physical-world domains is valuable. Privacy-preserving or federated data experience is also useful.

 - Ability to work from the San Francisco office five days a week and travel to farms in the western United States about one week per quarter.


COMPENSATION & BENEFITS

Base salary is $170,000 to $200,000 annually, plus 1% equity with four-year vesting and a one-year cliff. Healthcare and AI development tools are provided. Visa sponsorship is not available; candidates must be authorized to work in the United States.


LOCATION

On-site in San Francisco, California, five days per week.
